audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and the packet levelChart (both all-Diana), and the page was rated TRICKY 7/10 against a 55.26% win rate while its own prose calls the all-in 'nearly uncontestable'.
audit.why: Lux has no dash, blink or escape at any level. Diana marks from 900, and Lunar Rush costs nothing onto a marked target, so every row from 3 on is hers; levels 1-2 are a farm phase Diana survives behind Pale Cascade.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved onto the content chart (Diana on all seven rows), every why rewritten, and diff/diffRating/tone moved to FAVOURED 4.5/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes carried no numbers, and content spikes[0] put 'Q-E-R online' at levels 3-5 and content mid told you to 'pop R' from level 3.
audit.why: Moonfall is a level 6 ability. Diana's level 3 spike is Lunar Rush at 22s; the level 6 comparison is Moonfall 100/90/80 against Final Spark 60/50/40.
audit.corrected: Level 3 spike written as Lunar Rush only, Moonfall attached to 6, and the cooldowns named.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to 'minion-block' Light Binding (breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t) and winCon claimed you 'dash the silence' — Lux has no silence.
audit.why: Riot's text: Light Binding 'binds and deals damage to up to two enemy units'. It passes through the first unit and roots a second, so standing behind a minion does not stop it reaching you. Lux's only defensive tool is Prismatic Barrier (12s at rank 1); Final Spark gathers energy before firing, which is the window Moonfall exploits; Illumination is a bonus-damage proc she must auto-attack to ignite.
audit.corrected: The minion-block advice replaced with the two-unit behaviour and a sideways dodge; the silence removed; the Illumination auto tell stated in breakdown.early and content early.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint), and dosFull[2].d called Light Binding a 'fifteen-second invitation'.
audit.why: Light Binding is 10s flat at every rank. Lucent Singularity 10-8, Prismatic Barrier 12-10, Final Spark 60/50/40, Pale Cascade 15 at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in; the wrong 15s claim replaced with the no-dash consequence of Moonfall.

audit.whatIsWrong: Eighteen misgender findings (Lux called he/his) plus two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad), and phases[5].why's unsourced 'chunks half bars'.
audit.why: champ-gender.js lists lux as female; the bleeds sit under unrelated titles; the magnitude has no source.
audit.corrected: All fixed in the edits below.

notes: All seven full-layer sides disagreed with content win[] and the packet, which agreed with each other on an all-Diana chart, so the full layer was moved onto it — no paired win[N] edits exist because the content side was already correct. diff/diffRating/tone moved from TRICKY 7/10 to FAVOURED 4.5/10 to match 55.26% over 3,688 games and the page's own prose; carryRating left at 7.5/10. Real mechanical correction worth flagging: the page told the reader to minion-block Light Binding in three places — Riot's text says it binds up to two units, so a single minion in front does not stop it reaching you. The 'autoreset-burst-tell' missing interaction was written as an auto-attack tell, not a reset: Riot's Illumination text says her next attack ignites the charge for bonus damage and says nothing about resetting the attack timer, so I did not claim a reset.
